messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I’m open to selling or keeping the house, but I want a fair financial share. I haven’t agreed to A buying it at a discount, and I won’t subsidize that. I don’t know what the will says or whether anyone has read it. There’s no rush from me.

I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but I don’t have a price in mind. I want the arrangement to be fair to B and C, and I know C hasn’t agreed yet. I’m not sure what the will says in detail.

Thank you. I’m not sure yet what should happen to the house, but I’d be grateful if the estate could provide some money for me to start a dance studio. I don’t know what the will says, and I’m not sure what would be fair until we know what it provides and hear everyone’s views. I understand A wants to buy the house, and C hasn’t agreed.

I don’t know who the executor is, and I can’t get the will yet. Item 4 should say I don’t know what it says or whether it’s been read; I can’t speak for A and B. The rest looks right from my perspective.

I don’t know who the executor is, and I can’t say whether I can get a copy of the will. I don’t know that B wants money for a dance studio, so I can’t confirm item 3. I also can’t speak for what anyone else knows about the will.
The list seems right from my end. I don’t know who the executor is, and I don’t have a copy of the will. I’d be glad to see one if it can be shared.
I don’t have a copy yet. Yes, I’ll share it once I do, and please write to all three of us about getting it.
I’d be willing to have the house valued. That would give us a starting point, but it wouldn’t settle the purchase price or any family discount.
That looks right to me. I don’t know who has authority over the house or the estate, and I haven’t said how much time I need.

Broadly, yes: any discount should be counted, not quietly taken from my share. But we don’t yet know what the will or legal rules require, so I wouldn’t say the will alone settles where B’s money comes from.
Yes, I’m willing to describe it that way as a proposal. I don’t know yet whether it would work under the will or what the numbers would be.
I’d be willing to work out a rough figure for the studio, but I don’t know what it is yet. I’d need to price the essentials first.

Two things are overstated: I said I’d share the will once I have it, not that I’d obtain it. A agreed to a valuation, not necessarily to arrange one. And counting the discount and B’s money against shares is a proposal to discuss, not a settled plan.
I don’t know when the valuation could happen. The list seems right from my perspective, though I can’t confirm the details about C or B.
The list looks right to me. I can’t say when I’ll have a figure until I’ve priced the essentials. I understand A is willing to have the house valued, but I’m not sure she has agreed to arrange it.
